product.name: Sealed feedback lab
product.user: A Web2 engineer learning a privacy-preserving commit and reveal flow.
product.problem: Collect a bounded rating without publishing it before the reveal phase.
product.firstSlice: One participant commits, reveals once, and a public read confirms the rating.

agent.prompt: Use installed Midnight Expert Compact review and verification capabilities. Read PROJECT_SPEC.md, AGENTS.md, the contract, and focused tests. Implement only the sealed-feedback slice, preserve unrelated files, state the disclosure boundary before editing, run all named positive and negative cases, separate observed evidence from inference, and stop if a required tool is unavailable. Never request or expose secrets.

observations.symptom: The example run has not yet distinguished local simulation from confirmed network execution.
observations.evidence: This reference is a plan and contains no transaction identifier or indexed network read-back.
observations.proposedImprovement: Use an evidence template that requires network ID, confirmation, and indexed read-back before a deployment claim.
